items.title: Gay Meat – “Leslie”
items.summary: In April, North Carolina's Karl Kuehn, who records under the moniker Gay Meat, released his debut album Blue Water . The project is a loving reflection of passing time and the increasing weight of impending grief. On Wednesday, Gay Meat returned with "Leslie," a new song that was written for Blue Water but didn't make the final cut. It's precious and devastating. The post Gay Meat – “Leslie” appeared first on Stereogum .
